title: PredictionsManifest
description: Unified per-trace predictions interchange. Schema version 2.0. This is the single format used for ALL evaluation outputs from egm-classifier: training-time per-split eval (val/test/train), hybrid eval (mixed synthetic + IAFDB), inference benchmarks. Pairs: predictions_<eval_name>.csv (the flat row-per-trace table; CSV column order is the contract) + predictions_<eval_name>.json (this schema; carries the rows plus metadata so consumers can locate the source banks and the model checkpoint). Supersedes the v1 split into separate predictions/test_predictions schemas.

schema_version.description: Versioned schema identifier. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time.

eval_name.description: Identifier for what this eval set represents. Examples: 'val_epoch_42' for training-time per-epoch val, 'test' for a held-out synthetic test split, 'hybrid_eval_iafdb_v1' for a hybrid eval against IAFDB. Producer-defined; convention is snake_case.

n.description: Number of rows in the predictions array. Equal to len(predictions).

columns.description: CSV column order. Producer MUST emit exactly the x-csv-column-order list below; consumers MAY use this to validate the CSV they paired this JSON with.

producer.description: Where these predictions came from. Lets the inspection-tab consumer locate the trained model and the run record.

run_id.description: Run identifier matching the corresponding run.json (run_record.schema.json).

model_checkpoint.description: Path to the model artifact used to produce these predictions (relative to a project-defined root). Typical values: 'checkpoints/v1/best.pt' or 'exports/v1/best.onnx'.

model_artifact_sha256.description: Optional content hash of the model artifact for tamper detection.

sources.description: Pointers to the source banks each prediction row was drawn from. Lets the inspection-tab consumer re-load the actual waveform behind a row given (source, trace_index). At least one of synthetic_bank or iafdb_bank MUST be present.

synthetic_bank.description: Source synthetic bank, if any predictions came from synthetic.

path.description: Path to the HDF5 synthetic bank file.

schema_version.description: synthetic_bank schema version this bank conforms to (X.Y form).

iafdb_bank.description: Source IAFDB healthy bank, if any predictions came from IAFDB.

path.description: Path to the HDF5 IAFDB healthy bank file.

schema_version.description: iafdb_healthy_bank schema version this bank conforms to (X.Y form).

predictions.description: The per-trace predictions. One entry per evaluated trace.

Prediction.description: One model prediction on one evaluated trace. The required fields are always present regardless of source; the optional fields are populated when applicable to the row's source.

source.description: Which kind of bank this row came from. Drives which optional fields are populated.

split.description: Which split this row participated in. Free-form string. Examples: 'train', 'val', 'test', 'iafdb'. Producer-defined; convention is snake_case.

trace_index.description: Row index into the source bank's traces/ group. Combined with sources.<bank>.path, this uniquely identifies the trace's waveform.

true_label.description: Ground-truth class label. For the Phase 1 binary task: 0 = healthy, 1 = fibrotic. Integer (not enum) so multi-class severity (Phase 2) and pattern (Phase 3) classification can reuse this format without a schema break — see the project_plan.md classifier roadmap.

prob_fibrotic.description: Calibrated model output probability for the 'fibrotic' class. For multi-class models this is the post-softmax probability for class index 1; producer may add per-class probability columns in a future schema version.

pred_label.description: Predicted class label at the configured decision threshold. Same semantics as true_label.

logit.description: Optional. Raw model output before sigmoid/softmax. Useful for offline threshold sweeps and calibration analysis. Producer may omit when not available (e.g., when reading back from a checkpoint that was already post-processed).

simulation_id.description: Optional. Synthetic simulation/patient id (the patient-aware split unit on the synthetic side). Present when source == 'synthetic'.

patient_id.description: Optional. Real-data patient identifier (e.g., 'iaf1'..'iaf8' for IAFDB). Present when source == 'iafdb'.

fibrosis_density.description: Optional. Realized fibrosis density for the row. Present and non-zero for synthetic-fibrotic rows; 0.0 for IAFDB-healthy rows. Useful for shortcut-feature analysis (e.g., plotting prob_fibrotic vs fibrosis_density).

eval_index.description: Optional. 0-based position within the eval order. Useful when the predictions correspond to a specific iteration order (e.g., the order traces were fed to the model).

correct.description: Optional, derived. 1 iff pred_label == true_label, 0 otherwise. Semantically boolean; stored as 0/1 so CSV serializes as '0'/'1' rather than 'True'/'False' for downstream tool compatibility. Consumers may recompute from pred_label and true_label.
